structural_frame_source09.quantitative: All 63 protected non-terrain elements/view are 0 px delta. Rock/Terrain macro width/height remains within ~0.00002% of blockout in every official view; center shift <0.0001 px.
structural_frame_source09.source08_correction: Source08 was a real structural jump but failed the strict integrated visual review because pale/high-contrast facets dominated mobile and read as low-poly. Source09 fixes only that material hierarchy; no geometry/composition/camera changes.
structural_frame_source09.visual_jump: YES — blockout → Source09 is a frame-level transformation: accepted gate/bridge/road/stair sit on authored, subdued terrain with real depth, while architecture remains hierarchy leader.
structural_frame_source09.remaining_gap: Frame is intentionally not final overall because Walls, Bastion, Cabin/Camp, Vegetation, Props, Water/Shore and Background remain outside this family.

conclusion: PASS — Source09 closes the specific Source08 washout/low-poly material defect while preserving the approved macro frame.
